verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page has one thin first-party mention that workflows can be triggered by webhooks. That suggests some event-driven automation instead of polling. Nothing documents how an agent subscribes to events from connected downstream apps or MCP servers, so this is minimal, glancing support. Missing for 10: documented trigger/event subscription for connected apps, webhook registration and payload docs, a link between triggers and agents or hosted MCP servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
